'''Haasi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Valahari/Legends|Valahari]] who fought in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] under the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. He participated in the [[Battle of the Veil Nebula]] and perished in the fight.
